events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Hynde's influence
angles.copy: From Akron to the UK, Chrissie Hynde has been a rock icon for decades. We're celebrating her 75th birthday by cranking up The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the lead vocalist of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! The distinctive voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, is another year older. What's your favourite track he's fronted?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's Global James Bond Day! We're celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer-songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Imagine his legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled musical and cultural impact of John Lennon. His message of peace still resonates.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us some of Britain's most iconic comedy moments. Happy 87th to a true legend! What's your favourite Cleese role?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: The show must go on
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, the incomparable Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Remembering a true rock legend today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Revolutionary sound
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon remembered
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: Enduring legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we pause to remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose music and message continue to inspire millions worldwide.
